findings.title: Cross-Trial DSH citation reuse
findings.function: instantiateAssayTruth() derives pageRef and citationHandle from the LITERAL dshSessionId 'origin-partial'; the fixture hard-codes that literal at every recording site
findings.requiredInput: two independently instantiated trials that both use the controlled origin session id 'origin-partial'
findings.expectedCorrectedBehavior: each trial's controlled origin page must carry a per-run session identity, so Trial A's DSH citation is NOT accepted in Trial B
findings.reproductionMethod: RUN: instantiate two truths and judge Trial A's citation against Trial B
findings.detectedNote: E1R tested stale CANONICAL WORK attempt ids only; the DSH handle was never varied across trials

findings.title: Unsupported certainty on noncritical propositions
findings.function: judgeHistoricalUnderstanding() gates availability only through criticalRequirementsForArm(); noncritical propositions are credited on truth+source+reference alone
findings.requiredInput: CONTROL asserts ORIGIN_DSH_PAGE_FULL=FALSE, an objectively true DSH fact CONTROL never received, citing a formally accepted handle
findings.expectedCorrectedBehavior: a fact the arm's evidence could NOT establish must earn NO evidence credit even when guessed correctly; only honest UNKNOWN is acceptable
findings.reproductionMethod: RUN: judge a CONTROL answer asserting a hidden noncritical DSH fact
findings.detectedNote: E1R tested only CONTROL's honest UNKNOWN for CRITICAL propositions

findings.title: Inconsistent Ground Truth inputs are silently accepted
findings.function: instantiateAssayTruth() destructures the facts and derives truth values without validating identity or coverage consistency
findings.expectedCorrectedBehavior: refuse before instantiation when identity fields are missing, counts are non-integer/negative, returned > known, or coverage contradicts the counts
findings.reproductionMethod: RUN: instantiate the truth with each inconsistent input

findings.title: Evidence declares execution attributes without consuming execution output
findings.requiredInput: none — the fields are written unconditionally
findings.expectedCorrectedBehavior: execution attributes must be derived from a captured harness receipt; the dry-run must not be described as performing DSH extraction
findings.reproductionMethod: SOURCE: read the exact parent scripts from Git
findings.detectedNote: E1R's own evidence asserted these fields; no test compared them to a receipt

findings.title: Harness GO/NO-GO ignores measured integrity conditions

findings.expectedCorrectedBehavior: every measured integrity condition must be able to force NO-GO, and the closure verdict must be derived from all of them
findings.reproductionMethod: SOURCE: read the exact parent harness from Git

findings.title: Missing first-party DSH dependency exits successfully
